description: This file defines the AuthAPI class for handling authentication-related network requests, including login, token refresh, logout, and fetching user info, along with related data structures.

classes.name: AuthAPI
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods for authentication network operations.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, returns TokenPair.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens using a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out and invalidates the refresh token on backend.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user information from backend.

methods.name: mapTokenResponseToTokenPair
methods.description: Converts TokenResponse to TokenPair with expiration date.
